currentPhase.description: RC718 remains the promoted standalone product baseline after RC719 PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS. Stage B, Stage C and the controlled Stage D pilot remain accepted. ARC-WP-020 accepts the design-only learnit-identity-v1 model, separating canonical lineage identity, local installation identity and legacy compatibility keys, with an overlay-first reversible migration strategy. No identifier implementation or learner-state migration is authorized. The next allowed architecture step is a bounded additive read-only identity resolver and shadow diagnostic.

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is correctly configured but GitHub explicitly reports that it is not enforced on this private personal-account repository. Repository checks remain operational and auditable, but direct administrative bypass is not technically blocked by plan-level policy enforcement.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or adopt another GitHub plan/topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The Player working-file count is exactly 150, equal to the enforced budget. Further file growth would fail the source-tree contract and increase ownership fragmentation.
activeRisks.closureGate: remove or consolidate an existing Player file before adding another, or accept a dedicated source-budget change supported by architecture evidence

activeRisks.statement: Current RC718 identifiers are proven for local standalone compatibility and rename-safe progress, but global package, course, objective and activity lineage is not proven. Legacy-only content therefore cannot be safely deduplicated or merged across installations, devices or publishers by title, slug, position or digest inference.
activeRisks.closureGate: accept and validate complete canonical identity envelopes, an additive resolver, mixed-version compatibility evidence and a separate transactional migration before any global lineage or state-key cutover claim

activeRisks.statement: The RC719 promotion is recorded as accountable-owner PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS without raw device recordings or per-case test logs.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or continued acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC719 reservations are declared non-blocking but have not yet been itemized. Their scope and eventual corrective cost are therefore unknown.
activeRisks.closureGate: record each reservation in docs/product/RC719_RESERVATIONS.md before opening a corrective work package

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup, where GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced. Documented pull-request, CI, scope and governor procedures remain mandatory operational controls but can be administratively bypassed.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove this exception only after the repository reports the main-protection ruleset as enforced and an independent negative bypass test confirms the control.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Authorize one additive read-only identity resolver and shadow diagnostic from exact current main. It must classify complete canonical, legacy-only and invalid-partial identity without writing overlays, rewriting learner state, changing import decisions, UI, behavior, product identity or the accepted storage seam. It must modify only exact existing Player files so the working-file count remains 150, use disjoint developer, contradictory-QA, integrator and governor scopes, pass permanent Player CI and receive separate governor acceptance. Contract publication, identity writes and migration remain blocked.
